posts.content_md:
I recently purchased from eBay a PB530 laser from holokidd, together with his red laser. I have never recieved a package from the US this quickly, he is the fastest seller I've ever had on eBay.

In the item description it is stated tuning has to be done according included instructions, but such instructions were not with the package.

The seller hasn't replied to my question via ebay, so I thought there must be members here who have experience with those lasers. I believe I have been some nice dogs made with these lasers.

So how do I tune them? I unfortunately don't have a lightmeter yet, so I hope that isn't strictly required. Is it really just required or just a way to get the most mW from the unit?

Apart from that, I notice the green laser "driver board" is getting quite warm, is that normal? The red laser board stays cool.

Thanks in advance..

I’m sorry I did not receive your messages thru eBay, but now we are all here. Ok so you have both lasers up and running , what’s the power u are driving it with ? Yes the green driver can get warm ....

You have the heads on a heat sink?

posts.author: holomaker
posts.content_md:
> **Eikiewrote:↑Mon Sep 28, 2020 3:10 pm:** Just to be sure:I expand the laser beam, point at a glass plate and see if the reflection on a wall has those dark bandsAt the moment, the expanded beam looks very noisy, is this a product of dirty/wrong lens?

It looks like your using a coated lens for a different wavelength, if you dare to remove the factory installed optics you will get a beautiful expanded beam that’s perfect for doing one beam work, DCG and Photopolymer Denisyuk’s. A word about the factory installed optics , when expanding beam be sure to locate your optics at least 8”+ in front of laser ad they have a projected pinhole and your optics will work cleaner...
